signature.instructions: Given a medical text snippet, use a language model to analyze the text and predict the presence or absence of various substances, including heroin, cocaine, methamphetamine, benzodiazepine, rx opioid misuse, cannabis, injection drug use, and general drug use. Consider the context and nuances of the medical text to accurately identify substance use. Produce a list of the substances with a boolean value (True or False) indicating whether each substance was mentioned in the medical text as being used by the patient.
